sources.title: PixRestore — Unified Image Restoration via Pixel Diffusion Transformer
sources.snippet: Unified image restoration (UIR) aims to recover high-quality (HQ) content from low-quality (LQ) images with different degradations using a single model. Most recent methods adapt large pretrained text-to-image (T2I) latent diffusion models for their strong capacity and generative priors.
